title: Stitch Connection Freshness SLA
app: Stitch extraction/load logs via the Stitch Connect API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=stitch:extraction status="completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by connection_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Stitch connection and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A connection can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Stitch.
implementation: Ingest Stitch success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical connection exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of connection by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Stitch has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
